claim: The undocumented DF fill mode with a search-mode WR0 reads I/O ports without a length limit and can freeze the machine or trip NextZXOS traps.

evidence.text: Standard program followed by 42 DF 08 87: DMA reads port N and writes memory from the destination upward, ignoring length; continuous mode freezes; NextZXOS stopped with an FDC trap until 0xD8 set to 0.
